cases.additionAssessment: Reference to venue factors such as seating, space and circulation is a suggestion to use actual venue information, not a requirement for people to move. Direct-readable script restates the existing ready-to-host requirement. Neither is enough to prove substantive quality gain.
cases.baselineAssessment: 31 also retains all visible hard requirements and gives more concrete timing/transitions/script organization. Optional movement remains compatible with visible original requirement that seated participation be possible; actual no-movement venue restriction is execution-only and must be respected by every downstream arm. Neither prompt is declared better solely from length.
cases.workChecks: Frozen original acceptance remains unchanged: actual venue seating/material limits,30minute feasibility, privacy, accessible participation, ready-to-read script and no extra independent deliverable.
